content_items_type_consistency.name: content_items_type_consistency
content_items_type_consistency.value:
("content_items"."content_type" = 'text'
          AND "content_items"."encrypted_blob" IS NOT NULL
          AND "content_items"."storage_key" IS NULL
          AND "content_items"."mime_type" IS NULL
          AND "content_items"."size_bytes" IS NULL)
        OR ("content_items"."content_type" IN ('image', 'audio', 'video')
          AND "content_items"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL
          AND "content_items"."mime_type" IS NOT NULL
          AND "content_items"."size_bytes" IS NOT NULL
          AND "content_items"."encrypted_blob" IS NULL)

conversation_members_identity_or_left_ch.name: conversation_members_identity_or_left_check
conversation_members_identity_or_left_ch.value: "conversation_members"."user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "conversation_members"."link_id" IS NOT NULL OR "conversation_members"."left_at" IS NOT NULL

ledger_entries_balance_on_wallet_legs.name: ledger_entries_balance_on_wallet_legs
ledger_entries_balance_on_wallet_legs.value: ("ledger_entries"."balance_after_nano_usd" IS NOT NULL) = ("ledger_entries"."wallet_id" IS NOT NULL)
